notablePrerequisites: A non-Zombie creature has died this turn,
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Undead Sprinter, adding {R}.
When Undead Sprinter dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Undead Sprinter from your graveyard by paying {B}{R}.
Repeat.
